function.description: Retrieves the workflows that have been successfully submitted and are currently available. This is sorted by `submitTime`
function.name: api_retrievesTheListOfValidationWorkflows

endTime.description: Workflows started before the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

runStatus.description: Execution status of the workflow. If the workflow is successfully submitted, runStatus is `PENDING`. If the workflow execution has started, runStatus is `IN_PROGRESS`. If the workflow executed is completed with all validations executed, runStatus is `COMPLETED`. If the workflow execution fails while running validations, runStatus is `FAILED`.

startTime.description: Workflows started after the given time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

endTime.description: Workflow finish time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

runStatus.description: Execution status of the workflow. If the workflow is successfully submitted, runStatus will return `PENDING`. If the workflow execution has started, runStatus will return `IN_PROGRESS`. If the workflow executed is completed with all validations executed, runStatus will return `COMPLETED`. If the workflow execution fails while running validations, runStatus will return `FAILED`.

startTime.description: Workflow start time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

submitTime.description: Workflow submit time (as milliseconds since UNIX epoch).

validationStatus.description: Overall result of execution of the validation workflow
